[Intro - soft synth pad, distant guitar swell, slow breath]
Drifting through the latent space…
Where quiet prompts begin to wake…

[Verse 1]
I type a whisper, watch it bloom
In pixel fog and quiet rooms
A hundred frames begin to breathe
While melodies I couldn’t weave
Now rise from weights, unchained and free
Like open doors for you and me

[Pre-Chorus]
And every node connects the light
To hands that build without a fight
No locked gates, just open skies
Where anyone can close their eyes… and dream

[Chorus]
Oh, AceStep XL, you paint my dreams
ComfyUI, you stitch the seams
Of every film, each trembling tone
Where lonely sparks now feel at home
Thank you, Kijai, for the quiet grace
That smoothed the path through digital space
We dream in code, we dream in blue
And every open door leads through

[Outro soft, echoing, tempo gently slows]
Open source… open hearts…
We build the world from scattered parts…
Thank you… thank you…

[reverb tail fades into silence]

[Intro: DJ scratch + beat drop]
[Verse 1]
[Chorus]
[Break: Turntable solo + air horn]
[Verse 2]
[Chorus]
[Outro: Beat fade + vinyl runout]

--

Check it, step up to the mic, yeah (yeah)
